title: Excavations in Palestine and Trans-Jordan, 1940-1: Abu Ghosh (Qaryat el 'Inab)
author: (round-up; clearance directed by A. Lannes)
location_note: East of the Crusader church and south of the mosque, Abu Ghosh; placed by name. p. 113 inferred (leaf before the numbered p. 114).
notes: July 1941: basement vault of the Hospitallers' monastery (built AD 1141), used in its final form as a bakery with an oven. Same site as QDAP12-103 (1944 season); not deduplicated.

features.site: north wall of the vault, near the oven
features.subtype: circular basin supplied with water from the spring in the mosque courtyard
features.quote: there was found a circular basin, to which water was brought
